title: Academics, Exam Pattern, Grading - KITCOEK
text:
ACADEMICS AT KITCOEK — EXAM PATTERN, GRADING, CALENDAR

KITCOEK is an Autonomous institute affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur. It follows the NEP-2020 (National Education Policy 2020) curriculum from AY 2023-24 onwards.

EXAMINATION PATTERN (AUTONOMOUS)
For each theory subject (100 marks total):
- In-Semester Evaluation (ISE): 30 marks — assignments, quizzes, attendance, mini-projects throughout the semester
- Mid-Semester Examination (MSE): 20 marks — conducted midway through the semester
- End-Semester Examination (ESE): 50 marks — conducted at end of semester

For practical/lab subjects:
- Term Work (TW): 25 marks
- Oral/Practical Exam: 25 marks

GRADING SYSTEM (NEP-2020)
- O (Outstanding): 90-100 marks — 10 grade points
- A+ (Excellent): 80-89 marks — 9 grade points
- A (Very Good): 70-79 marks — 8 grade points
- B+ (Good): 60-69 marks — 7 grade points
- B (Above Average): 55-59 marks — 6 grade points
- C (Average): 50-54 marks — 5 grade points
- P (Pass): 45-49 marks — 4 grade points
- F (Fail): Below 45 marks — 0 grade points
CGPA is calculated as weighted average of grade points across all semesters.

CREDIT SYSTEM (NEP-2020)
- B.Tech: 160 credits over 4 years (8 semesters)
- Each subject carries 3-4 credits (1 credit = 1 hour lecture per week per semester)
- Additional credits for honors, minors, internships, projects
- Students can earn honors (extra 20 credits) or minor specialization (20 credits)

ACDEMIC CALENDAR AY 2026-27
- SEM-I (Odd Semester): July to November 2026
- SEM-II (Even Semester): December 2026 to April 2027
- MSE Odd Sem: September 2026 (approx)
- ESE Odd Sem: November 2026 (approx)
- MSE Even Sem: February 2027 (approx)
- ESE Even Sem: April 2027 (approx)
(Check official website for exact dates: https://www.kitcoek.in)

KEY ACADEMIC POLICIES
- Minimum 75% attendance required to appear for ESE
- Students below 75% attendance may apply for condonation with valid reasons
- Backlog subject re-examination conducted along with next batch exams
- Revaluation / Photocopy of answer sheet available on request
- Students can opt for honors or minor specialization from TY B.Tech

RESULT DECLARATION
- Results declared on the KITCOEK website: https://www.kitcoek.in/results
- Grievance redressal window open after result declaration
- Hall tickets available online before exams
